quote: if you offer someone a certainty of $400
content: Replication check: the certainty and reflection effects described in this paragraph come from Kahneman and Tversky (1979), and they replicate. Ruggeri et al. (2020) reproduced 94% of the original items with 4,098 participants in 19 countries, including the preference for a sure gain and the preference for a gamble over a sure loss. The effects were somewhat smaller than in the 1979 samples. The essay's use of this study is on solid ground.
